narrative: Price is being drawn back down toward the 511.70-498.25 sell-side pool. The 08-14 session ran 543.70, taking out the 531.70 equal-high cluster and the 08-13 high, then reversed the entire day to close at 527.00 -- the low of the bar and back below every level it had just swept. That is a buy-side liquidity raid followed by distribution, not a breakout. The unfilled bullish FVG at 484.20-511.70 from the 07-27 repricing is the deeper magnet beneath. Countering this: daily structure since 07-27 is still a clean series of higher highs and higher lows with no CHoCH, so the draw lower is a correction inside an uptrend rather than a reversal of it.
invalidation: The bearish case dies on a 1H close back above 543.70, which would confirm the 08-14 spike as a genuine break rather than a raid and re-open the upside. The bullish HTF structure dies on a daily close below 498.25 (the last higher low), which would print the first real CHoCH since 07-27 and convert this from a counter-trend short into a with-trend one.
